offers_products.reason: Manufactures dispensing closures, steel and aluminum food cans, and custom plastic containers.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured packaging; services are only incidental to product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells packaging to consumer products and food companies, not to households directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are branded and private-label consumer goods and food companies buying closures, cans and containers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat orders of packaging consumed by food and consumer goods customers, often under multi-year supply contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Packaging for food, pet food, health care and household products is essential, so demand is stable.

big_ticket.reason: Closures, cans and containers are low-cost items bought frequently in high volumes.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured packaging goods, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are the world's best-known consumer products and food companies.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs many manufacturing plants for metal and plastic packaging that need continuing capital investment.
